mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and positively impact S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during periods of low FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate may signal economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite rising unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: Declines in both GDP and housing starts indicate weak demand, which may negatively impact S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite declining GDPC1 and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production may signal supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite declining INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment may indicate a strong labor market, positively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative returns occur despite payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in retail sales may indicate weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite RSAFS slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates alongside high unemployment may indicate economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns occur despite low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation without corresponding interest rate increases may lead to negative real returns, impacting S&P 500.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% and FEDFUNDS does not
failure_condition: Positive real returns occur despite CPIAUCSL increase without FEDFUNDS response.
